title: Once MettleUp Plus is switched on, an iPhone member would lose the paid features with no way to buy them, and be told to pay through Google Play
what: The free-month rules and the locks on paid features are the same on Android and iPhone. On an iPhone there is no store to buy from yet, so a Buy tap answers 'Buying opens soon' or 'Google Play is not available right now', while the page says 'You pay through Google Play'. After the free month an iPhone member who is not at a MettleUp gym loses the watch, older charts, suggested weights and calculators and cannot get them back. Apple rejects apps that mention another phone platform's store and apps that sell digital features without Apple's own payment.
expected: Before the iPhone app ships with Plus switched on: either iPhone members keep every feature free until Apple payment is built, or the Plus page buys through Apple and names the App Store, never Google Play.
how_often: every iPhone member after the free month, once the iPhone app ships with Plus on
fix_line: Keep every feature open on iPhone until Apple payment exists, and show App Store words there instead of Google Play

title: The member app ships dozens of open-source packages but shows none of their licence notices
what: The Credits page lists four things: the RepDB pictures, the Everkinetic drawings, the body map and the fonts. The app is built from about fifty outside packages (React Native, Expo and others), most under licences such as MIT or Apache that ask for their copyright notice to travel with every copy. No screen, file or build step in the member app gathers those notices.
expected: Settings has an 'Open-source licences' list (made at build time from the packages) or the Credits page links to one.
fix_line: Add a build step that collects every package's licence and show it from the Credits page

title: The record of where exercise pictures come from leaves out the main picture source, and the Credits page undersells what was changed
what: The exercise library's 'where everything comes from' record lists only the Everkinetic drawings, yet the start and end pictures most members see come from RepDB, and 238 pictures are MettleUp's own. RepDB's terms (credit line, no reuse as a dataset, no AI restyling) are written nowhere in that record. The Credits page says the RepDB pictures were only 'resized', while the picture list says they were resized and recoloured.
expected: The rights record names every picture source with its terms (RepDB, Everkinetic, our own pictures and clips), and the Credits page says truthfully what was changed.
fix_line: Add RepDB and our own pictures to the rights record and make the Credits change note say recoloured

items.reason: Plus is bought only through Google Play with price, period and how to cancel shown; the GitHub update card relies on the install-source check already reported; Play shows no policy issue. Not checkable here: the Data safety form itself (no copy given; the app sends crash logs and voice clips that must be declared), target API and permissions list (outside this area).

Clips and own pictures are CC0 or own work; rest sounds are made by our own script; icons are hand-drawn paths, not copied; fonts credited under OFL. MettleUp name and logo trademark status not checkable from code.
